_doc: Per-icon settings for iconforge. mode 'generate' draws a new icon from 'describe' and the style references only (the current art is not sent); 'output' writes under another file name (the kod must point at it).

icebolt.bgf.describe: a single jagged shard of pale blue ice flying diagonally upward, with a short frosty trail

iicenova.bgf.describe: a burst of sharp ice crystals exploding outward from a bright blue-white centre, a frost nova

iholybl.bgf.describe: an open hand raised in blessing, engulfed in a blaze of golden-white holy fire

irift.bgf.describe: a dark swirling purple-black rift torn open in the air like a doorway, with a faint glow at its edges

ispectate.bgf.describe: a pale translucent ghostly figure of a person fading out of the world

ispirsword.bgf.describe: a glowing spectral sword made of white-gold light, pointing upward, with a soft halo

iunholyt.bgf.describe: a dark clawed hand wreathed in sickly green and black unholy energy

iwallice.bgf.describe: a row of tall jagged ice spikes rising from the ground, forming a wall of ice

iappraise.bgf.describe: a pair of golden merchant's balance scales, gleaming gold with two hanging pans

duskrat.bgf.describe: a dusk rat: a sleek, sinister giant rat with dark slate-purple fur, a sickly pale belly, a few glowing violet eyes and wisps of dark poisonous vapour around its fangs

ratking.bgf.describe: the rat king: a huge, bloated giant rat with mangy grey-brown fur, a battered golden crown on its head and a ragged royal red cape over its back

ratkingx.bgf.describe: the dead rat king: a huge, bloated giant rat lying dead on its side, with mangy grey-brown fur, its battered golden crown fallen beside it and a ragged red cape

ratsold.bgf.describe: a rat soldier: a giant rat wearing a dented iron helmet and a battered leather jerkin with rusty iron plates strapped to its shoulders

ratsoldx.bgf.describe: a dead rat soldier: a giant rat lying dead on its side, still wearing its dented iron helmet and battered leather jerkin with rusty iron plates
